cypan.2021.1.1.source_format: Official exam paper in Greek, as published by the organisers; the Greek original is transcribed as printed and translated into English for the bank
cypan.2021.1.1.source_variant_note: The cover page (instructions; not transcribed) states that the paper has three parts (A: six questions of 5 marks, B: four of 10 marks, C: two of 15 marks), that a non-programmable calculator is allowed, that the only libraries allowed in programs are <iostream>, <fstream>, <string>, <iomanip>, <cmath> and <climits>, and that the C++ version is C++98 (ISO/IEC 14882:1998) without compiler extensions; the paper ends with an attached formula sheet of C++ functions and constants (τυπολόγιο, page 14), which is not transcribed.
